thread:
Sophia: Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained throughput drop on ded-uk pool-12. ~12% TPS down, several workers restarted. Initial signs: GPU OOM + slab fragmentation. I'm attaching profiler + logs.

Matt: Which model/route? Any recent rollouts?

Sophia: route: /v1/generate redwood-13b-int8-smallbatch on ded-uk-gpu-2. We started kernel-heuristics canary (rev: kh/2026-03-18) ~2h ago.

infra-bot: deploy canary kh/2026-03-18 -> ded-uk-gpu-2 completed at 2026-03-18T09:14:22Z

Alejandra: Can you paste the allocator/gpu logs and KV stats? KV hit rate shift could explain eviction churn.

Sophia: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:22:14Z] GPU0: alloc failed size=1.2GiB reason=OOM
[2026-03-18T09:22:14Z] kernel_selector: switching kernel fastpath->fallback (scratch_alloc_failed)
[2026-03-18T09:22:15Z] kvcache: evict count=1424 prefetched=0 hit_rate=0.62 -> 0.10
[2026-03-18T09:22:16Z] worker[pid=4123]: respawn (oom)
```

Ryan: KV hit_rate collapse to 0.10 is huge. Prefetch stalled? Batching heuristics may be routing small sequences to a kernel variant with large scratch allocation; when alloc fails it triggers fallback but leaves fragment. That + aggressive prefetch -> eviction spiral.

Matt: I pulled runtime profiler (cpu+gpu). flamegraph shows hot path at kernel_select() during batch formation — selection call is happening per-request instead of per-batch in some codepath.

Alejandra: That explains spike in scratch allocs. Quick mitigation: rollback kernel heuristics canary and pin kernel to stable-int8 for that shard; increase kvcache low-watermark to delay eviction. Can we roll back now?

Sophia: Rolling back canary: `infra rollback kh/2026-03-18 --targets=ded-uk-gpu-2` — starting.

infra-bot: rollback kh/2026-03-18 -> ded-uk-gpu-2 initiated at 2026-03-18T09:26:40Z

Sophia: After rollback, initial telemetry: worker restarts stopped, KV hit_rate recovering to ~0.58, TPS climbing back.

Jess: Postmortem/tasking: 1) postmortem with timeline + perf diffs 2) add unit/regression test: small-batch int8 + KV churn 3) add metric alert on sudden kvcache hit_rate drop 4) audit kernel selection to ensure selection is done per-batch not per-request.

Matt: I'll add a unit test and a lint rule around kernel_selector callsite.

Sophia: Filed INC-2026-03-18-07, impact: ~12% throughput for ~15m, ~5 workers restarted. Closing live incident after rollback. Will follow up with perf graphs and postmortem.

Alejandra: :thumbsup:
